How we got here

Our story

  1. 2012 · Mumbai

    How we met

    Our names landed next to each other on a list at college in Mumbai. Same batch, same classrooms, and we were friends within a few weeks.

  2. 2012–2025 · Friends

    Thirteen years of friendship

    We stayed friends long after college. Steffy moved to the US, we saw each other when we could, and for a while we lost touch altogether.

  3. May 2025

    A phone call

    Gaurish called to talk about how he felt about her and asked her out. Steffy took a few weeks to think it over, then said yes.

  4. 2025–2026 · Long distance

    A year and a half apart

    Long phone calls most nights, and one of us on a plane most months.

  5. March 29, 2026 · Longwood Gardens

    The proposal

    With friends who have loved us since 2012 right by our side, Gaurish proposed—and Steffy said yes!

  6. November 21, 2026

    The wedding

    Forty of our favorite people and one long table. We’d love you to be there.

Where & when

The details

An intimate celebration for forty guests. The ceremony and dinner both take place at the same venue, so once you arrive you can settle in for the evening.

Date
Saturday, November 21, 2026. Guest Arrival: 3:30 PM, ceremony at 4:00 pm.
Venue
Peninsula Prime, Jetton Village
19918 N Cove Rd, Cornelius, NC 28031 · Open in Maps →
Format
Ceremony, drinks, and a seated dinner — all in one place. Dancing from 7:30; plan for the evening to run until 9:30 pm.

We’d love to see our family and friends dress up with us! Cocktail or Indian attire is welcomed.

Charlotte Douglas Airport (CLT) is about 25–30 minutes by car, and rideshares are easy across the area. See Travel & stay for hotels nearby.
Children

The evening

Schedule

For guests from out of town

Travel & stay

Getting there. Charlotte Douglas Airport (CLT) is about 25–30 minutes away by car. We’d suggest either renting a car or using Uber or Lyft — rideshares are easy to find at the airport and right across the Charlotte area, though a car of your own is worth it if you’d like to explore Lake Norman or Charlotte while you’re here.

Where to stay. A few places close to the venue:

  • Homewood Suites by Hilton Davidsonabout 8 minutes
  • Aloft Charlotte Lake Normanabout 10 minutes
  • Courtyard by Marriott Charlotte Lake Normanabout 10 minutes

Getting around. Peninsula Prime is roughly 8–10 minutes by taxi or rideshare from most of the Cornelius and Davidson hotels. Uber and Lyft are widely available in the area, so getting to and from the celebration should be straightforward.

Make a weekend of it. If you’re staying a little longer, a few of our local favorites:

  • Morning coffeeSummit Coffee in downtown Davidson — good local coffee and an unhurried place to sit.
  • A scenic walkJetton Park in Cornelius, for lakefront trails and views out over Lake Norman.
  • Sunday breakfastToast Cafe in Davidson or Famous Toastery in Cornelius, for a proper classic breakfast.

Good to know

Questions

Can I bring a guest?

Yes! We are keeping our celebration small and intimate with just 40 of our closest loved ones, and we would love for you to bring your plus-one. Infants are also warmly welcomed! Please include their details when filling out your RSVP response.

Are children welcome?

Infants and babies-in-arms are warmly welcome — we know they’re happiest right there with you. Beyond that, our micro-wedding reception is an intimate evening meant for grown-ups: a curated dinner, interactive games and a DJ set that runs late. We kindly ask that you make arrangements for your children so you can relax and celebrate with us.

What should I wear?

We’d love to see our family and friends dress up with us — the dress code is cocktail or festive attire. Whether you go for Western cocktail wear or Indian attire, we want you to feel comfortable, elegant and ready to celebrate. A quick guide if it helps:

  • Women · WesternCocktail-length dresses, midi dresses, dressy jumpsuits, or elegant evening separates.
  • Women · IndianSarees (draped or pre-stitched), light lehengas, Anarkalis, or fusion wear.
  • Men · WesternA dark or neutral suit — navy, charcoal, gray — or a tailored blazer with dress trousers and a shirt. Ties optional.
  • Men · IndianKurta-pajama sets with a tailored Nehru jacket or Modi vest.

Footwear. The whole celebration is indoors, with carpeted flooring on the main level and a well-lit indoor staircase up to the mezzanine. There’s no grass or gravel to cross, so wear your favorite heels or dress shoes and be comfortable.

Is it indoors or outdoors?

Entirely indoors. We’re in a private dining space with a carpeted main level and an indoor staircase up to the mezzanine, so nothing depends on the weather.

Where do I park?

Parking is available on site, but if you’re planning on drinking, we recommend grabbing an Uber or Lyft so you can celebrate worry-free!

What about gifts?

Your presence is genuinely the point. If you’d like to gift something, there are a few notes below.

Who do I contact on the day?

For any last-minute questions or event details, please reach out directly to:

  • Friend & event point of contactSanket Kulkarni (862) 800-1796
  • Venue event coordinatorMekenzie Lee (704) 677-1807
